text:
You want to expand your multi-channel outreach by adding effective Instagram DM prospecting for dental clinics and appointment setting.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d love to help with this. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis and workflow support, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization. That background has trained me to work carefully, stay organized, and manage high-volume outreach tasks with consistency.

I’m comfortable helping with structured outreach processes and keeping messaging clear, targeted, and tracked. For your dental clinic campaigns, I can support Instagram DM outreach in a way that fits alongside your email, cold calling, and LinkedIn efforts.

What kind of DM process are you looking for right now—lead sourcing, message sending, follow-up, or full appointment-setting support?
